name: CEANOTHUS AMERICANUS
gi_symptoms: Enormous enlargement of the spleen. Splenitis; pain all up the left side. Deep-seated pain in left hypochondrium, hypertrophy of spleen. Leucæmia. Violent dyspnœa. Menses profuse, and yellow weakening leucorrhœa. Unable to lie on left side. Pain in liver and back.

source.title: CEANOTHUS AMERICANUS - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
